issues.explanation: For childhood witnessed domestic violence, police/people in uniform as prominent triggers are hard to reconcile without any supporting appraisal or memory content involving intervention, institutions, or authority figures. The rest of the profile centers on interpersonal danger and betrayal rather than authority-linked trauma cues.

issues.item: Triggers: Authority Figures: People in uniform
issues.explanation: The appraisal that perpetrators faced no consequences implies a salient justice/accountability theme, but no other trigger, memory, or threat item reflects legal, disclosure, or aftermath themes. This makes the accountability item feel disconnected from the rest of the formulation.

issues.item: Negative Appraisals: No Accountability: The people responsible have faced no consequences
issues.explanation: Pain recall suggests re-experiencing bodily injury to the same body parts as during the event, which is difficult to reconcile with a trauma type specified as witnessed domestic violence rather than direct physical victimization, absent any indication he was also physically assaulted.

issues.item: Memory: Pain Recall: When the memory returns I feel physical pain in the same parts of my body as during the event
issues.explanation: Avoiding enclosed spaces is not well supported by the trigger, threat, memory, or appraisal content. The rest of the profile does not indicate confinement, entrapment, or panic in enclosed settings, so this strategy appears to target a symptom cluster not represented elsewhere.

issues.item: Triggers: Authority Figures: People in uniform
issues.explanation: Authority figures/people in uniform are not a coherent trigger for witnessed childhood domestic violence in the absence of any appraisal or memory content involving police, institutions, or official intervention; this trigger is hard to link to the rest of the profile.

issues.item: Maladaptive Strategies: Avoid Enclosed Spaces: Enclosed or confined spaces
issues.explanation: Avoiding enclosed spaces is poorly matched to the rest of the profile: no trigger, threat, appraisal, or memory item suggests confinement, entrapment, or claustrophobic trauma themes, so this strategy appears to address a different symptom cluster.

issues.item: Threat: Threat from Strangers: I feel threatened by strangers approaching me even in ordinary situations
issues.explanation: Feeling specifically threatened by strangers in ordinary situations does not fit well with the stated trauma and the rest of the profile, which centers more on interpersonal betrayal/conflict than unknown public attackers; hypervigilance is plausible, but the stranger-specific focus is insufficiently supported here.

issues.item: Memory: Pain Recall: When the memory returns I feel physical pain in the same parts of my body as during the event
issues.explanation: Re-experiencing physical pain in the same body parts as during the event is difficult to reconcile with a witnessed domestic violence trauma, since the patient was described as witnessing rather than being physically injured in the indexed trauma.
